title: Compute equivalent stiffnesses and nondimensional parameters
action: Using the geometric and material properties given in Table 1 (L=100 µm, b=15 µm, hb=3 µm, hp=0.5 µm, Eb=169 GPa, Ep=78.6 GPa, νb=0.06, νp=0.3, ρb=2331 kg/m³, ρp=7500 kg/m³, e31=-9.29 C/m², εv=8.854e-12 F/m, d=1 µm, and damage D when applicable), compute the neutral-axis position zc, the effective bending stiffness (EI)eq, axial stiffness (EA)eq, couple-stress contribution (μA l²)eq, and the nondimensional coefficients α, ē₃₁, β, as well as any other required intermediate constants. Store all parameters for use by the DQM solver.
description: Preparation of geometry- and material-dependent coefficients that define the nondimensional static ODE and boundary conditions.

title: Solve static deflection and produce tip displacement curves
action: Implement DQM to solve the nondimensional static governing equation with cantilever boundary conditions. Using parameters from previous step, compute tip displacement W(ξ=1) for electrode voltage sweeps. Required case strings: 'classic_Vp_neg1', 'classic_Vp_0', 'classic_Vp_1', 'present_Vp_neg1', 'present_Vp_0', 'present_Vp_1'.
description: Nondimensional tip displacement versus applied electrode voltage for classical and size‑dependent models at different piezoelectric voltages. Required case strings as listed.
output_schema: columns: case (string, one of 'classic_Vp_neg1','classic_Vp_0','classic_Vp_1','present_Vp_neg1','present_Vp_0','present_Vp_1'), V_bar (float), W_tip (float)

title: Extract pull-in voltages
action: From DQM sweep, determine pull-in voltage for parameter combinations listed in instruction (V̄_p sweep, D=0.2, gap sweep, linear/nonlinear comparison).
description: Nondimensional pull-in voltage for studied parameter combinations. Required case strings include: V̄_p sweep (classic/present, V_p from -1.5 to 1.5), D=0.2 (present), gap sweep (classic/present nonlinear d=1..4), linear/nonlinear comparison (present).
output_schema: columns: case (string, exact values as listed in instruction), V_pl (float)
